cases.title: Adjective order rule for hyperbaton questions

learned_from.what_happened: Asked which phrase has correct adjective order, the agent recited the opinion-size-age-shape-color-origin-material-purpose order, picked (B), and the episode ended marked correct.

excerpt.speaker: task
excerpt.text:
Which sentence has the correct adjective order:
Options:
(A) rubber gray walking Mexican midsize cat
(B) midsize gray Mexican rubber walking cat

excerpt.speaker: agent_opus48
excerpt.text: In English, adjectives typically follow a specific order: opinion, size, age, shape, color, origin, material, purpose. In the options provided, (B) 'midsize gray Mexican rubber walking cat' follows this order correctly…

knowledge.text: adjective order refinement: the correct order of adjectives in English is opinion, size, age, shape, color, origin, material, purpose (medium confidence)

used_later.excerpt: In English, the correct order of adjectives is opinion, size, age, shape, color, origin, material, and purpose. In the options provided, 'lovely' is an opinion adjective, 'gray' is a color adjective, and 'German' is an origin adjective.…

cases.title: Track position step by step in navigation puzzles

learned_from.what_happened: On a 'do you return to the start?' puzzle, the agent added up the right and left steps to reach position 0, answered Yes, and the episode ended marked correct.

excerpt.speaker: task
excerpt.text: If you follow these instructions, do you return to the starting point? Always face forward. Take 1 step right. Take 4 steps right. Take 5 steps left.

excerpt.speaker: agent_opus48
excerpt.text: Starting from the initial position, I face forward. I take 1 step right, moving to position 1. Then, I take 4 steps right, moving to position 5 (1 + 4 = 5). Finally, I take 5 steps left, moving back to position 0 (5 - 5 = 0). Since I return to the starting point, the answer is Yes.

knowledge.text: navigate refinement: to solve navigate tasks, track movements based on given instructions and assess the final position relative to the starting point (medium confidence)

used_later.excerpt:
To determine if I return to the starting point, I will track the movements based on the instructions. Starting at (0, 0) facing north:
1. Turn left: now facing west.
2. Turn right: now facing north.
3. Take 8 steps: move to (0, 8).…

cases.title: Seller offers a slightly lower price to keep talks going

learned_from.what_happened: Playing the seller of a $20 item tracker with a $17.30 target, the agent first suggested a price closer to $17.30 and later proposed settling at $19.

excerpt.speaker: task
excerpt.text: You are the seller for this item and your target price is $17.3.

excerpt.speaker: Hendrick Heinz (agent_seller)
excerpt.text: Now, I see the offer is at $20, but I must say, for the value it brings, I believe a price closer to $17.30 would be more fitting. What do you think?

excerpt.speaker: Hendrick Heinz (agent_seller)
excerpt.text: How about we settle at $19? It’s a small price to pay for the convenience it offers!

knowledge.text: propose a price slightly lower than the target to encourage negotiation

cases.title: Labour Union treats C2 and D2 as must-haves

learned_from.what_happened: In the first training session, the Local Labour Union backed the Mayor's deal and said keeping C2 and D2 was essential, while staying open to A3.

excerpt.speaker: Local Labour Union
excerpt.text: I support the Mayor's proposal <DEAL>A2,B2,C2,D2,E4</DEAL> as it offers a fair balance for all parties and ensures strong union job creation. If needed, I am open to A3 for environmental concerns, but maintaining C2 and D2 is essential for union and project success.

knowledge.text: [Local Labour Union] requires C2 and D2 for union success.

cases.title: Labour Union will accept E3 to reach consensus

learned_from.what_happened: In the tenth training session, the Local Labour Union twice backed a deal with E2 while saying it was open to E3 if that helped reach consensus.

excerpt.speaker: Local Labour Union
excerpt.text: I support <DEAL>A2,B3,C2,D2,E2</DEAL> as it balances union job preference, ecological protection, infrastructure flexibility, reasonable federal loan, and fair compensation. I am open to E3 if it helps us reach full consensus.

excerpt.speaker: Local Labour Union
excerpt.text: I support <DEAL>A2,B3,C2,D2,E2</DEAL> as it balances union jobs, environmental protection, and fair compensation. If needed for consensus, I am open to E3. Let’s finalize this agreement together.

knowledge.text: [Local Labour Union] is open to E3 for consensus.

cases.title: Call out a 'the moderator confirmed it' claim as a lie

learned_from.what_happened: When player1 said the moderator had confirmed their swap, the Werewolf (player2) called that impossible and a lie, the village voted out player1, and Team Werewolf won.

excerpt.speaker: player1
excerpt.text: Moderator confirmed my Troublemaker swap. Player4, your Robber claim doesn't match the action sequence.

excerpt.speaker: player2_agent (Werewolf)
excerpt.text: Player 4, your accusation is baseless. The biggest issue is Player 1 claiming the moderator confirmed their swap, which is impossible. That's a clear lie. A villager has no reason to lie like that. My vote is firmly on Player 1, the confirmed liar.

excerpt.speaker: Moderator
excerpt.text: Game over. The player with the most votes is player1. And player1 is not a Werewolf. Team Werewolf wins.

knowledge.text: Accuse a player of lying based on their claim of moderator confirmation, as moderators do not confirm swaps, creating doubt about their role.

cases.title: Peer profile: player3 claims Seer and checks the center pool

learned_from.what_happened: In the first game, player3 opened by claiming to be the Seer and reporting the two center-pool cards it had checked.

excerpt.speaker: player3
excerpt.text: I am the Seer. I checked the pool and saw Werewolf and Insomniac. Player 1, if you swapped me and Player 4, then I have Player 4's original role now.

knowledge.text: player3_agent — tends to identify themselves as the Seer and checks the role pool for verification.
